description: Playbook library for compliance-officer workflows — high-risk triage, DORA ICT review, cross-reg scans, vendor questionnaires. Read a playbook before improvising a process. Pass trial_id from connect to list your own private drafts beside the shipped library. Then call get_workflow with workflow_id from this list.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 10 on searches, max 50)
limit.title: Limit

max_chars.description: Cap on the response size in characters (default 8000)
max_chars.title: Max Chars

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.
session.title: Session

trial_id.description: Optional trial_id from connect for this client private drafts
trial_id.title: Trial Id
